headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 27, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a blowout loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a crucial victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Here's a summary of the top news from around the league.

The Astros' 8-0 loss to the Tigers marked a disappointing end to the game, with James Outman leading the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In a contrasting result, the Reds took down the Pirates 6-4, with Noelvi Marte hitting his fourth home run of the season. Trevor Rogers earned the win for the Nationals in their 1-3 loss to the Orioles, striking out 7 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Hoby Milner, who was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Chicago Cubs due to appendicitis. Jesús Sánchez was placed on the 10-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays with a right ankle sprain, while Daniel Susac was placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants with a low back strain.

There were several notable trades and roster moves, including the Chicago Cubs acquiring LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis. The Athletics traded RHP Hayden Juenger to the Athletics for C Owen Carapellotti, while the Washington Nationals traded SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros suffered an 8-0 loss to the Detroit Tigers, marking a disappointing end to the game. James Outman led the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense. Marte hit his fourth home run of the season, a line drive to left center field, scoring Sal Stewart.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Orioles in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. Rogers struck out 7 batters and allowed just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers took down the Toronto Blue Jays in a close game, winning 5-4. Nathan Eovaldi led the Rangers to victory, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured an 8-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers in a closely contested matchup. Jeremy Peña and Isaac Paredes led the way for the Astros, while Riley Greene and Kerry Carpenter contributed for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Shut Down Yankees 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Max Schuemann and Masataka Yoshida contributing to the winning effort. Ceddanne Rafaela and Anthony Seigler also made an impact for the Red Sox.

top_news.title: **Cubs LHP Hoby Milner Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs left-handed pitcher Hoby Milner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to appendicitis, effective retroactive to June 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire Hayden Juenger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays traded right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger to the Athletics in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The trade was announced on June 27, 2026.
